steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Preflight one verified local change for delivery by checking branch and ref identity, merge base, credentials status, automation stops, evidence, documentation, and remote readiness without mutation.
hard_gates: Preflight is read-only: readiness never authorizes packaging, push, pull-request change, merge, deployment, or provider mutation.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: A reviewed change, repository state, delivery policy, and intended publication boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Package verified local changes into bisectable commits, coherent version and changelog metadata, credential-safe PR material, and a push handoff without remote writes.
